culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Kamakura City's public manners ordinance (in force April 2019) names nuisance behaviours it asks visitors to avoid: eating or drinking while walking in narrow or crowded places where you could soil someone's clothes; stopping in the roadway to take photos; photographing near railway tracks or other dangerous spots; leaving hiking paths; cutting or picking plants; using fire near grass on paths; running past walkers, or riding bikes and motorbikes, on narrow or crowded paths. It is a manners ordinance with no penalties, and it doesn't ban eating while walking.
culture-and-protocol.note: Kamakura only, from the city's ordinance page.
